estimators.replicate: seednoise.estimator.estimate(fixed-bank population, A = B = full bank).sigma_agg

rules.recipe_pair: |gap| > 2*sqrt(2/R)*sigma, sigma leave-pair-out on the size band (k05)
rules.size_step: |gap| > 2*sqrt((sigma_s^2 + sigma_s'^2)/R), each sigma leave-recipe-out on its band (new)
rules.seed_count: ceil(2*(2*sigma/delta)^2) at p25 and p50 absolute pair gaps (k05)

gap: full-bank battery average over kept traits, mean of R runs; k05 half-mean gap recorded as a check
